label: Ollama models (unload only)
description: Unloads every model Ollama holds in GPU memory and leaves the server running. Works for Ollama run by hand, in a container or as a service.

spec.label: Ollama models
stop:
import json
import sys
import urllib.request

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:11434"
opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
try:
    with opener.open(BASE + "/api/ps", timeout=5) as reply:
        models = json.load(reply).get("models") or []
except Exception as exc:
    sys.stderr.write("ollama is not reachable, nothing to unload: %s\n" % exc)
    sys.exit(0)
failed = 0
for entry in models:
    name = entry.get("model") or entry.get("name")
    if not name:
        continue
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        BASE + "/api/generate",
        data=json.dumps({"model": name, "keep_alive": 0}).encode(),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        method="POST",
    )
    try:
        opener.open(request, timeout=30).read()
        sys.stderr.write("unloaded %s\n" % name)
    except Exception as exc:
        failed += 1
        sys.stderr.write("could not unload %s: %s\n" % (name, exc))
sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)
